therapy.en: It was her teenage experiences that led Claudia to start her own horse therapy centre.
therapy.zh: 正是青少年时期的经历促使 Claudia 创办了自己的马匹治疗中心。

therapy.en: That's really allowed a breakthrough with immune therapy over the past decade.
therapy.zh: 这确实让过去十年中的免疫疗法取得了突破。

therapy.en: Now, this social media trend is called rejection therapy, but it's not a proper form of therapy.
therapy.zh: 虽然这种社交媒体潮流被称为“拒绝疗法”，但它并不是一种正式的治疗手段。

therapy.en: Now, this social media trend is called rejection therapy, but it's not a proper form of therapy.
therapy.zh: 虽然这种社交媒体潮流被称为“拒绝疗法”，但它并不是一种正式的治疗手段。

therapy.en: Various animals can be used in therapy, but horses are particularly suitable as they're very sensitive to human emotions.
therapy.zh: 各种动物都可以用于治疗，但马特别合适，因为它们对人类的情绪非常敏感。

thought.en: Yet we still call it the same river. He thought that change is natural.
thought.zh: 然而我们仍然称它为同一条河。他认为改变是自然的。

thought.en: How many animals are thought to take part in The Great Migration every year?
thought.zh: 据估计，每年有多少动物参与这场大迁徙？

thought.en: This episode was inspired by a thought I had while talking to some friends recently.
thought.zh: 这期节目的灵感来自于我最近和一些朋友聊天时产生的一个想法。

thought.en: I thought it was pull theory... ...which I'm afraid was the wrong answer.
thought.zh: 我以为是拉力理论……恐怕我猜错了。

thought.en: To be precise, this asteroid is thought to contain precious metals worth 10 quintillion dollars.
thought.zh: 准确地说，这颗小行星据信包含价值高达 10 京（10 quintillion）美元的贵金属。

therefore.en: And therefore, by having that toast you are showing: "Look I trust you.
therefore.zh: 因此，通过敬酒，你是在表明：“看，我信任你。

therefore.en: And therefore, should he be treated differently when it comes to international law?
therefore.zh: 因此，在涉及国际法时，他应该受到不同的对待吗？

therefore.en: Therefore, she believes that the bar needs to be higher – parents need to make their expectations higher.
therefore.zh: 因此，她认为标准需要提高——父母需要提高他们的期望。

therefore.en: A novelty is something which is new and unusual and therefore exciting.
therefore.zh: 新鲜事物（A novelty）是指新颖、不寻常并因此令人兴奋的东西。

therefore.en: His lawyers wanted to argue that he was mentally ill and therefore not responsible for his actions.
therefore.zh: 他的律师想辩称他患有精神疾病，因此不承担责任。

threat.en: Day and night, people occupied the square, camping out despite the threat of violence.
threat.zh: 日以继夜，人们占领了广场，不顾暴力威胁在那里露营。

threat.en: He believed the Catholic population of Ireland was a direct threat to England's new republic.
threat.zh: 他认为爱尔兰的天主教人口对英格兰的新共和国构成了直接威胁。

threat.en: Being blind to something means failing to notice it or recognise it as a threat.
threat.zh: 对某事视而不见意味着未能注意到它或没有将它识别为威胁。

threat.en: They pursued him across the Mediterranean, determined to stamp out the threat once and for all.
threat.zh: 他们在整个地中海对穷追不舍，决心一劳永逸地根除这个威胁。

threat.en: There was economic pressure, political instability, nationalism, and a fear of an external threat.
threat.zh: 当时存在经济压力、政治不稳定、民族主义以及对外部威胁的恐惧。

thoughtful.en: So, hyper-vigilant means very, very careful and thoughtful.
thoughtful.zh: 所以，hyper-vigilant 的意思是极其小心、深思熟虑。

thoughtful.en: So your goal should be to use AI as a tool that works with your questions, and that only works if your questions are thoughtful and intentional.​
thoughtful.zh: 所以你的目标应该是把AI当作一个与你的提问相配合的工具，而这只有在你的提问经过深思熟虑且带有明确意图时才能奏效。

thoughtful.en: Online, in meetings or in online classes or online calls with your friends, it’s easy to stay silent or get ignored, so a clear and thoughtful question can really help you understand better and get people to understand you better.
thoughtful.zh: 在线上，无论是开会、上在线课程还是与朋友进行网络通话，保持沉默或被忽视都很容易，因此一个清晰、周到的问题真的能大有帮助，让你更好地理解他人，也让别人更好地理解你。

theory.en: In theory, it’s a day where the Egyptian people remember and honour the police.
theory.zh: 从理论上讲，这是埃及人民缅怀和纪念警察的日子。

theory.en: Nudge theory says that people's behaviour can be changed by small prompts or nudges.
theory.zh: “助推理论”认为，人们的行为可以通过微小的提示或助推来改变。

theory.en: So…what did happen, or at least what are some theories about what happened?
theory.zh: 那么……究竟发生了什么，或者说，关于发生了什么，又有哪些猜测呢？

theory.en: In the 1950s, a Soviet scientist named Dmitry Belyaev decided to test this theory.
theory.zh: 在上世纪五十年代，一位名叫德米特里·别利亚耶夫的苏联科学家决定检验这个理论。

theory.en: It sounded perfectly good in theory, but in practice it never actually worked.
theory.zh: 这在理论上听起来非常完美，但在实践中却从未真正成功过。

threaten.en: The rise of nationalism and euroscepticism in some countries also threatens the EU.
threaten.zh: 一些国家民族主义和欧洲怀疑主义的抬头也对欧盟构成了威胁。

threaten.en: His wife had discovered the affair, was understandably furious, and had threatened to leave him.
threaten.zh: 他的妻子发现了这段私情，自然是勃然大怒，并威胁要离开他。

threaten.en: But when prices fall — or even stop rising — the same group feels threatened.
threaten.zh: 但当房价下跌——甚至停止上涨时——同一群人就会感到受到威胁。

threaten.en: They need to be able to investigate powerful people without being controlled or threatened by them.
threaten.zh: 他们必须能够在不受权贵控制或威胁的情况下调查有权有势的人。

threaten.en: The first line of the report says, "Global ecosystem degradation and collapse threatens the UK's national security."
threaten.zh: 报告的第一行写道：“全球生态系统的退化和崩溃威胁着英国的国家安全。”

thrill.en: To make matters worse, the military wasn’t exactly thrilled to see an Islamist calling the shots.
thrill.zh: 更糟糕的是，军方对于看到一个伊斯兰主义者发号施令可是一点也不高兴。

thrill.en: Well done. OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with the phrase give something a kick – meaning to add extra thrill or excitement.
thrill.zh: 做得好。好的。让我们复习一下今天学到的词汇，首先是短语 give something a kick——意思是增加额外的刺激或兴奋感。

throne.en: That he was the son of the king and the rightful heir to the throne of Athens.
throne.zh: 他是国王的儿子，也是雅典王位的合法继承人。

throne.en: For example, the hit television show Game of Thrones was a cultural happening for millennials in the 2010s.
throne.zh: 例如，热门电视剧《权力的游戏》是 2010 年代千禧一代的一个文化事件。

throne.en: He even wrote a draft letter of abdication, where he would step down from the throne, before deciding to stay.
throne.zh: 他甚至写了一份退位诏书草稿，打算从王位上退下来，但最终决定留下来。

throne.en: But, and it is a big but, he still wasn’t crown prince; he wasn’t technically in line to the throne.
throne.zh: 但是，这是一个很大的“但是”，他当时还不是王储；从严格意义上讲，他并不在王位继承序列中。

throne.en: This all changed in 2012, when his father, Salman, was appointed Crown Prince, in other words, next in line to the throne.
throne.zh: 这一切在2012年发生了改变，当时他的父亲萨勒曼被任命为王位继承人，也就是王储。

thorough.en: If you have a deep knowledge of a subject, you have a thorough understanding of it, gained from experience and study.
thorough.zh: 如果你对某一学科有“深厚的知识”（deep knowledge），你就通过经验和学习对其有了透彻的理解。

thorough.en: A deep knowledge means a thorough understanding of a subject gained from experience and study, not just knowing the basic facts.
thorough.zh: “深厚的知识”（deep knowledge）意味着通过经验和学习对某一学科有透彻的理解，而不仅仅是了解基本事实。

throughout.en: Throughout the Cold War, the West had seen him as a reliable anti-communist ally.
throughout.zh: 在整个冷战期间，西方一直视他为可靠的反共盟友。

throughout.en: What is universal is that happiness is something humans, throughout history, have always sought.
throughout.zh: 但普遍的共识是，幸福是人类在整个历史长河中一直在追求的东西。

throughout.en: He also suffered from poor health which would remain a constant challenge throughout his life.
throughout.zh: 他还饱受健康状况不佳的困扰，这将成为他一生中挥之不去的挑战。

throughout.en: What began in Victorian drawing rooms spread across the industrialised world throughout the 20th century.
throughout.zh: 始于维多利亚时代客厅的这股风潮，在整个20世纪传遍了整个工业化世界。

throughout.en: Throughout the 20th century, the Vice Presidency gradually morphed into a position with real influence.
throughout.zh: 在整个20世纪，副总统职位逐渐演变成一个具有真正影响力的职位。

theft.en: The Colosseum has survived earthquakes, fires, theft, the collapse of the Roman Empire, and centuries of damage.
theft.zh: 斗兽场经受住了地震、火灾、盗窃、罗马帝国的崩溃以及数百年的破坏。

theft.en: In some settings, such as at car parks or in enclosed spaces, cameras appear to reduce certain crimes, particularly theft.
theft.zh: 在某些环境中，例如停车场或封闭空间，摄像头似乎确实减少了某些犯罪，特别是盗窃。

theft.en: Movies like Indiana Jones and Tomb Raider have made the subject popular, but the theft of ancient objects is a serious problem in some parts of the world.
theft.zh: 像《夺宝奇兵》和《古墓丽影》这样的电影让这个话题变得很受欢迎，但偷盗古代物件在世界某些地方是一个严重的问题。

theft.en: And there was this utterly bizarre situation in which he was both on trial for the crime of conspiracy, fraud and theft AND acting as an MP, a member of parliament.
theft.zh: 于是出现了一个极其荒诞的局面：他一方面因阴谋、欺诈和盗窃罪受审，另一方面竟然还在担任国会议员。

theft.en: Most people accept this kind of surveillance because it is linked to safety and theft prevention, but it still means we are being watched in a private business that we visit regularly.
theft.zh: 大多数人接受这种监控，因为它与安全和防盗有关，但这仍然意味着我们在我们经常光顾的私人企业里被监视着。

throat.en: But first, Georgie, a question. We all know the common cold – now, that’s the illness that makes you cough and sneeze, have a sore throat and headache.
throat.zh: 但首先，Georgie，有个问题。我们都知道普通感冒——也就是那种让你咳嗽、打喷嚏、喉咙痛和头疼的疾病。

throat.en: He turned and said, "What do you suppose, except that at a single nod of mine, both of you could have your throats cut on the spot?"
throat.zh: 他转过身说：“你们觉得呢，除了只要我点一下头，你们两个的喉咙当场就会被割断之外？”

throat.en: The ceremony involved young men screaming sexual insults at each other, others forced to kneel down and kiss a skull, and pretend to cut the throat of another member.
throat.zh: 仪式包括年轻男子互相尖叫黄色笑话，其他人被迫跪下亲吻头骨，并假装割断另一名成员的喉咙。

throat.en: Here's Mr Nish Mehta, an ear, nose and throat surgeon at Royal National ENT Hospital in London, giving a beginners' class to BBC Radio 4 programme, Inside Health: Hearing is an amazing sense.
throat.zh: 这位是伦敦皇家国家耳鼻喉医院的耳鼻喉科外科医生Nish Mehta，他正在为BBC Radio 4的节目《Inside Health》上一堂入门课：听觉是一种神奇的感官。

thick.en: I love noodles, yes. I think my favourite are udon – the big thick ones.
thick.zh: 我挺喜欢面条的。我想我最喜欢乌冬面——那种又粗又劲道的面。

thick.en: Their brains were smaller, their bones heavier, their foreheads thick and heavy.
thick.zh: 他们的脑容量较小，骨骼更沉重，前额厚重。

thick.en: On one island, finches had strong, thick beaks for cracking seeds.
thick.zh: 在一个岛上，雀类拥有强壮而厚实的喙，用来砸开种子。

thick.en: Firstly, Rome was well fortified. Its walls were high and thick.
thick.zh: 首先，罗马防御坚固。它的城墙又高又厚。

thick.en: The pressure sphere had to be incredibly strong, so it was made from reinforced steel 9 centimetres thick.
thick.zh: 耐压球体必须极其坚固，因此它是由9厘米厚的增强钢制成的。

thereby.en: It is, yes. Right again! OK, let’s recap the vocabulary we’ve learned in the programme, starting with rage bait, social media content designed to provoke anger, thereby encouraging people to engage with it.
thereby.zh: 是的，没错。又答对了！好的，让我们回顾一下我们在节目中学到的词汇，从“愤怒诱饵”开始，这是一种旨在激起愤怒的社交媒体内容，从而鼓励人们与之互动。

thereby.en: The class worked tirelessly, collating records and writing letters, and in 2022, a bill was passed that officially exonerated Elizabeth Johnson Jr., thereby clearing the last convicted person in the Salem Witch Trials.
thereby.zh: 全班同学不知疲倦地工作，整理档案，写信求助，终于在2022年，一项法案通过了，正式宣布小伊丽莎白·约翰逊无罪，从而洗清了塞勒姆审巫案中最后一位被定罪者的罪名。

thereby.en: In Malta, the tiny Mediterranean island where I used to live, citizenship was given to foreigners on the condition they bought property over a certain value, thereby reducing the housing supply for locals and pushing up prices.
thereby.zh: 在马耳他，这个我曾经居住过的小型地中海岛国，外国人在购买超过一定价值的房产的条件下可以获得公民身份，从而减少了当地人的住房供应并推高了房价。

thrive.en: Do you struggle to make those relationships, or do you thrive on them, or are you perfectly happy without them?
thrive.zh: 你在维系这些关系时感到挣扎吗？还是乐在其中？又或者没有它们你也过得挺开心？

thrash.en: He is left in it, thrashing and shouting, until he exhausts himself and goes quiet.
thrash.zh: 他被留在束衣里，挣扎着、大喊大叫，直到筋疲力尽、安静下来。

thanksgiving.en: Fireworks. Services of thanksgiving in churches across the country, and a grand ceremony at St Paul’s Cathedral.
thanksgiving.zh: 烟花。全国各地教堂的感恩礼拜，以及在圣保罗大教堂举行的盛大仪式。

thief.en: So, he has had what we might call a “portfolio career” so far: buffalo hunter, stagecoach driver, horse thief, and now deputy marshal.
thief.zh: 所以到目前为止，他的履历可以说相当“多元”：猎野牛的猎人、驿马车车夫、盗马贼，如今又成了副警长。

thief.en: The Cowboys, which is what they were actually called, they were a loose network of cattle thieves and smugglers who operated out of the surrounding hills and valleys.
thief.zh: “牛仔帮”确实就是他们的名字，这是一个松散的团伙网络，由盗牛贼和走私犯组成，活动范围遍布周围的山丘和山谷。

theatre.en: It became a symbol of his rule; part theatre, part menace.
theatre.zh: 它成了他统治的象征；既有戏剧性，又带有一丝威胁。

theatre.en: He reportedly once appeared in the theatre dressed as Venus, complete with wig and dress, delighting in the outrage of Rome’s conservative senators.
theatre.zh: 据报道，他曾有一次打扮成 Venus 出现在剧院里，戴着假发穿着长袍，对罗马保守派元老院议员的愤怒感到洋洋得意。

theatre.en: There was also a personal dimension. Johnny Behan and Wyatt Earp had been involved with the same woman, Josephine Marcus, a theatre performer who had been briefly engaged to Behan before she broke it off.
theatre.zh: 这其中还有私人恩怨。Johnny Behan 和 Wyatt Earp 曾同时与一位名叫 Josephine Marcus 的女演员有过感情纠葛，她曾短暂与 Behan 订婚，但后来解除了婚约。

theme.en: One theme is the university student’s perpetual feeling of not having enough money.
theme.zh: 一个主题是大学生永远感觉没有足够的钱。

theme.en: This was written in 1937, and this broad theme has continued to this very day.
theme.zh: 写下这段话是在1937年，而这一大致的基调一直延续到了今天。

theme.en: As a reminder, this was part one of a three-part mini-series on the theme of animals.
theme.zh: 提醒一下，这是关于动物主题的三部曲系列的第一部分。

theme.en: As a reminder, this is part one of a three-part mini-series on the theme of “university”.
theme.zh: 提醒一下，这是关于“大学”主题的三集迷你系列的第一部分。

theme.en: And while each dictionary might have its own criteria, there are usually a few common themes.
theme.zh: 尽管每家词典可能都有自己的评选标准，但通常都会出现一些共同的主题。

thus.en: There was no hope. His parents made the agonising decision to remove his feeding tube, thus sealing his fate.
thus.zh: 已经没有希望了。他的父母痛苦地做出决定，撤掉他的喂食管，也因此为他的命运画上了句号。

thus.en: If I get writer’s block, and I’m just not sure where to go next in a script, I might paste in what I’ve written thus far and ask it to give me three different routes to take it next.
thus.zh: 如果我遇到了写作瓶颈，不确定脚本接下来该怎么写，我可能会把已经写好的内容贴进去，让它给我提供三种不同的后续思路。

thus.en: According to a 2012 biography by the Russian-American journalist Masha Gessen, and I’m quoting directly, 'Putin and his colleagues were reduced mainly to collecting press clippings, thus contributing to the mountains of useless information produced by the KGB.'
thus.zh: 根据俄罗斯裔美国记者Masha Gessen在2012年撰写的一本传记，我直接引用：“Putin和他的同事们主要沦为收集剪报，从而为KGB制造的浩瀚无用的信息堆添砖加瓦。”

thus.en: The use of Wagner troops also meant that Putin could delay his partial mobilisation, the calling up of reservist troops from the general population, and thus continue his claim that this was not a war that would affect the regular Russian population.
thus.zh: 使用瓦格纳部队还意味着普京可以推迟他的部分动员令——即从普通民众中征召预备役部队，从而继续坚称这不是一场会影响普通俄罗斯民众的战争。

thirdly.en: And thirdly, it shouldn’t be about a highly controversial or divisive topic.
thirdly.zh: 第三，它不应该是极具争议或容易引发分歧的话题。

thirdly.en: Thirdly, apparently, they do most of their hardest work in the morning.
thirdly.zh: 第三，显然，他们最艰难的工作大都在早晨完成。

thirdly.en: And thirdly there is the fact that he doesn’t want to be seen to have waited until the very last minute.
thirdly.zh: 第三，事实是他不想被看作是等到了最后一刻。

thirdly.en: Not exactly coffee shop reading. Thirdly, this manifesto was the first time the general public had heard anything from the Unabomber.
thirdly.zh: 这可不是那种在咖啡馆里随手翻阅的读物。第三，这份宣言是公众第一次听到 The Unabomber 的声音。

thirdly.en: And thirdly, it was just too large and had too many competing different ethnic and religious groups—the Arabs, the Greeks, the Armenians, and the Slavs, to name but a few.
thirdly.zh: 第三，它实在太大了，有着太多相互竞争的不同民族和宗教群体——仅举几例，就有阿拉伯人、希腊人、亚美尼亚人和斯拉夫人都。

thesis.en: His thesis was so advanced that, according to someone on his dissertation panel, "maybe 10 or 12 men in the country understood or appreciated it."
thesis.zh: 他的论文是如此先进，以至于根据他论文答辩委员会成员的说法，“全国大概只有 10 到 12 个人能理解或欣赏它。”

thesis.en: This clear passion for understanding the past earned him a place at Oxford University, where he read history, and for his thesis, he went one step further.
thesis.zh: 这种对了解过去的明确热情让他获得了 Oxford University 的席位，他在那里攻读历史，为了完成论文，他更进一步。

theoretical.en: I averaged over two and a half hours of driving study, practical or theoretical, a day in August.
theoretical.zh: 在八月份，我平均每天花两个半小时以上的时间学习驾驶，包括实操或理论。

theoretical.en: This became the theoretical foundation of the general purpose computer.
theoretical.zh: 这成为了通用计算机的理论基础。

theoretical.en: I think it’s fair to say that in this process, language became functional or real for me, not just theoretical.
theoretical.zh: 我觉得可以公平地说，在这个过程中，语言对我来说变得具有功能性、变得真实了，而不仅仅是理论上的。

theoretical.en: Perhaps it all sounded theoretical, but in January of 1692, he noticed something unusual happening in his own house.
theoretical.zh: 也许这一切听起来很理论化，但在1692年1月，他在自己的家里发现了一些异常情况。

theoretical.en: If this sounds theoretical, it really isn’t.
theoretical.zh: 如果这听起来像是理论上的假设，那可就大错特错了。

thirst.en: The journey was brutal. Lawrence, Faisal’s fighters, and the fearsome Bedouin cavalry, led by a fierce warrior named Auda abu Tayi, crossed nearly 1000 kilometres of some of the harshest terrain on Earth, suffering from thirst, exhaustion, and the relentless heat.
thirst.zh: 旅程非常残酷。Lawrence、Prince Faisal 的战士们以及由勇猛战士 Auda abu Tayi 领导的可怕的贝都因骑兵，穿越了地球上近 1000 公里最恶劣的地形，忍受着干渴、疲惫和无情的酷热。

thrust.en: Truman became deeply involved in wartime decision-making, a relationship that would prove crucial when Roosevelt’s sudden death thrust Truman into the role of Commander-in-Chief in 1945.
thrust.zh: 杜鲁门深度参与了战时决策，这种关系在后来罗斯福突然去世、杜鲁门于1945年接任三军统帅时被证明至关重要。

thigh.en: Lucan had a large scar, 30 centimetres long, on his right thigh.
thigh.zh: Lucan 的右大腿上有一条 30 厘米长的巨大疤痕。

threshold.en: Fewer jobs are eligible for sponsorship, and you have to meet high salary thresholds.
threshold.zh: 有资格获得担保的工作变少了，而且你必须满足很高的薪资门槛。

theorem.en: This wasn’t a typical textbook. It was basically a huge collection of thousands of mathematical results and theorems, but with very few explanations or proofs.
theorem.zh: 这不是一本典型的教科书。它基本上是数千个数学结果和定理的巨大集合，但几乎没有什么解释或证明。

thread.en: Secretly, she gave him a ball of thread and a sword.
thread.zh: 她秘密地给了他一团线和一把剑。

thread.en: Theseus used the sword to fight and kill the Minotaur, and he used the thread to find his way back out of the labyrinth.
thread.zh: 忒修斯用剑与米诺陶洛斯战斗并杀死了它，他又用线找到了走出迷宫的路。
